report.rationale: Circulation_loss is the only candidate compatible with all three diagnostic bits. Independent noisy repeats confirm bits 2 and 3, further weakening actuator_stiction and controller_timing_fault. None_of_the_above remains the strongest alternative because its conflict is confined to the unrepeated bit 1. Probabilities are approximate: shared reliability uncertainty prevents treating the five observations as fully independent confirmation.

Retain circulation_loss: it is the only candidate compatible with all observed bits. The strongest compatibility-based alternative, none_of_the_above, conflicts only with E12, whose signature bit has not been repeated. Actuator_stiction conflicts with E07 and E14; controller_timing_fault with E02 and E17; sensor_bias with all five observations. Repeats support existing signature bits but do not add distinct signature constraints. The shared reliability regime means these conflicts do not definitively exclude alternatives. Probabilities remain judgmental, not calibrated posteriors, because priors and error rates are unspecified.
